feeCurrentness.statedAs: Les droits prévus au règlement ont été indexés à compter du 1er avril 2026 selon l'avis publié à la Partie 1 de la Gazette officielle du Québec le 22 novembre 2025, page 623.
feeCurrentness.mechanism: Tout droit ou coût ainsi que toute contribution pour le financement de la Fondation pour la biodiversité et la faune du Québec, exigible en vertu du présent règlement, sont indexés annuellement, au 1er avril de chaque année, en appliquant à leur valeur de l’année précédente le pourcentage de variation annuelle, calculé pour le mois de juin de l’année précédente, de l’indice général des prix à la consommation (IPC) publié par Statistique Canada.

absenceEvidence.finding: r.12 annexe I establishes «Orignal sans bois», «Cerf de Virginie, femelle ou mâle, dont les bois mesurent moins de 7 cm pour toutes les zones sauf pour la zone 20», «Ours noir valide pour la zone 13» and «Ours noir valide pour la zone 16». r.32 annexe I prices none of them: it prices the zone-20 antlerless deer only, and paragraphs d) and e) of its article 2 are '(paragraphe abrogé)'. The two draw-allocated licences are exactly the ones with no fee row.
absenceEvidence.closedBy: NOT CLOSED. A fee may sit in another instrument, in a draw-specific tariff, or be nil. NO FEE IS SHOWN for these authorizations and the evidentiary state is kept, per CLAUDE.md §41A as amended: an omitted fee with its evidence is the correct answer.
absenceEvidence.instrumentNote: Instrument named in full in `instruments`; no bare section numbers are used in this record.

schemaGapsReported: FEE CURRENTNESS AND AUTHORIZATION VALIDITY ARE INDEPENDENT CLOCKS IN QUÉBEC, and the amended rule asks whether the fee source is current 'for that authorization's own validity basis'. Here they do not align and cannot be made to: the FEE is indexed annually on 1 April (s.15), while the BIG-GAME LICENCE it buys expires on an event (r.12 s.11). A fee can be perfectly current while the authorization has already expired, and vice versa. Both are recorded separately — source.feeCurrentness and the row's validityBasis — rather than collapsed into one 'current' flag.

THE FEE COLUMN IS HEADED «Droits annuels» — ANNUAL — FOR LICENCES THAT ARE NOT ANNUAL. Québec's own fee table calls these annual fees while r.12 s.11 makes most of them expire at season end or on tagging. That is the authority contradicting its own framing, not an error of ours. Recorded verbatim as amount.columnHeading; NOT resolved.
laneNotes: THE ANNEXE I AMOUNT IS NOT WHAT A HUNTER PAYS. A mandatory contribution to the Fondation pour la biodiversité et la faune du Québec is set per licence category in annexe VI and is payable in addition. Carried on every row as mandatoryAddition. Showing the annexe I figure alone understates the cost of every Québec licence.
Annexe VI as published lists «b) Cerf de Virginie ... 5,30 $» on the category line AND 5,30 $ on both of its sub-lines i and ii for non-residents. Quoted as published; not tidied.

The annexe VI contribution for «Petit gibier» is expressly «sauf pour la chasse du lièvre ou du lapin à queue blanche au moyen de collet», which has its own line — so the snare licence is excluded from the petit gibier contribution and carries its own.
Resident and non-resident are separate rows throughout. No figure is shown without its category.
Non-resident rows are absent for «Lièvre ou lapin à queue blanche au moyen de collet» in BOTH regulations. Recorded, not interpreted.

Re-emitted 2026-09-23 against the landed contract: scope.enginTypes became scope.gearClasses (the authority's own numbers as identity), implements moved to gearClassesDerived marked display-only, and EVERY citation in every row now carries its instrument — no bare section numbers anywhere, per 'a citation without its instrument is not a citation'.
